entities.summary: Rayko Ivanov Daskalov was a Bulgarian interwar politician of the Bulgarian Agrarian National Union (BANU). He led the republican Radomir Rebellion organised by deserted Bulgarian Army troops in 1918 against the government. From 1919 to 1923 Daskalov was a prominent member of the BAPU governments which were in power in Bulgaria in the early post-World War I period.
